name: needlewhile
description: An opt-in warm yarn-ball Portal for the time while Codex works.

interface.shortDescription: A tactile yarn-ball toy for the time between prompt and answer.
interface.longDescription: Needlewhile quietly tracks a Codex turn and asks the host to render one tiny borderless textile Portal icon at task start. Click it to enter the local fine-fiber yarn toy, shuffle color palettes, watch live task state, and see a closing performance when the turn ends.
defaultPrompt: Open the Needlewhile Portal for this task.
Check whether the Needlewhile companion is running.
